description: Header file defining enums, structs, macros, and function prototypes for managing the Media Transport Protocol (MTP) execution in the system. It includes protocol types, content types, error counters, scheduling actions, and external dependencies related to various MTP implementations (e.g., STOMP, CoAP, MQTT, UDS).

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_MtpSendItem_Init
methods.description: Initializes a mtp_send_item_t structure by resetting or setting default values.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_Init
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks for MTP execution subsystem.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_ScheduleExit
methods.description: Schedules the MTP to exit the execution thread gracefully.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Activates any scheduled reconnects or exits after all queued messages are sent.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_StompMain
methods.description: Main thread function for STOMP protocol handling.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_StompWakeup
methods.description: Wakes up or signals the STOMP thread for activity.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_CoapMain
methods.description: Main thread function for CoAP protocol handling.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_CoapWakeup
methods.description: Wakes up or signals the CoAP thread for activity.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_MqttMain
methods.description: Main thread function for MQTT protocol handling.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_MqttWakeup
methods.description: Wakes up or signals the MQTT thread for activity.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_UdsMain
methods.description: Main thread function for UDS protocol handling.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_UdsWakeup
methods.description: Wakes up or signals the UDS thread for activity.
